payload.title: Saltbridge hold on in 4-3 classic
payload.story: Saltbridge Athletic defeated Northgate FC 4-3. Ibrahim Calard scored 4 times, netting in the 24th, 33rd, 34th and 79th minutes to put the visitors in control. Joel Lorola replied with 3 goals for Northgate, including strikes in the 38th, 77th and 87th minutes, but his late goal could not complete the comeback. Saltbridge outshot Northgate 25 to 20 and had 10 shots on target to 6, while producing 3.70 xG to Northgate's 2.97. The finish was chaotic with 34 turnovers as both sides traded chances late on.
key_moments: 38' Lorola gets Northgate on the board.

translations.es: Saltbridge Athletic derrotó a Northgate FC 4-3. Ibrahim Calard marcó 4 veces, anotando en los minutos 24, 33, 34 y 79 para poner a los visitantes en control. Joel Lorola respondió con 3 goles para Northgate, incluyendo tantos en los minutos 38, 77 y 87, pero su gol tardío no pudo completar la remontada. Saltbridge superó a Northgate en disparos 25 a 20 y tuvo 10 tiros a puerta contra 6, mientras generaba 3.70 xG frente a 2.97 de Northgate. El cierre fue caótico con 34 pérdidas de posesión mientras ambos equipos intercambiaban ocasiones al final.
